title: Open Software Assurance Passport (OSAP) Protocol Version 1.1 Specification Schema
description: Formal JSON Schema defining structure, data types, constraints, governance metadata, evidence manifests, and cryptographic proofs for Open Software Assurance Passport v1.1.

passportId.description: Unique identifier for the software assurance passport.

issuer.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier (DID) of the issuing authority node.

subject.description: Target software component, package, or system metadata.

softwareId.description: Unique software package or system identifier.

name.description: Human-readable name of the software application or component.

version.description: Semantic version identifier of the software build.

buildHash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the build artifact or commit.

repository.description: Source code repository URI or workspace reference.

issuedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the passport was issued.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the passport expires.

assuranceLevel.description: Assurance and security classification tier of the passport.

governance.description: Governance and regulatory audit compliance metadata.

complianceStandard.description: List of regulatory standards validated (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, OWASP ASVS, NIST).

auditState.description: Audit state verdict (e.g. PASSED_VERIFIED, QUALIFIED, AUDITED).

policyDigest.description: Cryptographic hash of active UAIGOS policy governance ruleset.

evidence.description: List of verifiable attestation evidence items supporting the passport.

evidenceId.description: Unique identifier for the evidence item.

type.description: Type classification of evidence (e.g. CODE_AUDIT_REPORT, CONTRACT_CONFORMANCE).

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum digest of the raw evidence payload.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of evidence collection.

attestation.description: Human and machine readable attestation statement.

proof.description: Cryptographic signature proof linking the passport content to the issuing node DID.

type.description: Cryptographic proof suite type (e.g. EaorcsHmacSha256, Ed25519Signature2020).

created.description: Timestamp when signature proof was generated.

verificationMethod.description: DID URL fragment referencing the verification key (e.g. did:eaorcs:node-1#key-1).

proofPurpose.description: Proof purpose conforming to W3C DID specification.

proofValue.description: Hexadecimal or multibase signature proof string.

trustExchange.description: P2P Trust Exchange routing and relay metadata.
